study_system.region: Buenos Aires National Wildlife Refuge / Altar Valley, Arizona, USA
study_system.reintroduction: three source ponds received reintroduced larvae in 2003 after regional extirpation and predator control
study_system.scientific_role: fresh EOG-specific independent validation candidate for the post-Glanville two-layer predictor

known_from_publication: the system is a reintroduced wetland metapopulation
published models analyse colonization/extinction and landscape resistance
published aggregate conclusions about hydroperiod, isolation and resistance were viewed during candidate screening
independence_boundary.rule: Published findings may justify comparator class and process relevance but must not tune EOG world thresholds, Layer-B features, holdout years or favourable/adverse rules.
independence_boundary.label: fresh EOG-specific independent validation; not completely outcome-naive ecological-system validation

source.official_usgs_release_title: Chiricahua leopard frog - Arizona: influence of landscape features on landscape resistance and colonization dynamics (presence data, wind speed, air temp; hydroperiod spatial coordinates)
source.source_freeze_rule: freeze version-4 metadata, every published file name/size/checksum and exact bytes before any occupancy row is parsed

public_process_basis.site_definition: published methods define sites as wetlands potentially suitable for reproduction rather than only wetlands known to become occupied
public_process_basis.founder_sources: three known 2003 reintroduction ponds provide a biologically explicit source-state origin
public_process_basis.availability: hydroperiod/water permanence is a patch-state covariate and intermittent sites can become unavailable or high-extinction patches
public_process_basis.process_match: published work explicitly models annual occupancy, colonization/extinction and distance/landscape-mediated immigration
public_process_basis.process_closure_boundary: Forecasts remain conditional on the declared refuge wetland universe and known/current internal source ponds; complete closure to every external immigrant is not asserted.

node_universe_gate.critical_question: Does the Figshare release contain response-free coordinates/hydroperiod for the full potentially suitable wetland network independent of future occupancy?
pass_if: stable site IDs and coordinates are available without occupancy response rows
node inclusion is based on potential wetland habitat/survey design rather than ever-occupied response
hydroperiod/availability can be represented independently of future occupancy
stop_if: coordinates exist only for sites selected by eventual occupancy
site identity or geometry is ambiguous without using occupancy outcomes

response_semantics_gate.target_candidate: annual survey-recorded pond occupancy/colonization conditional on pond availability
response_semantics_gate.positive_candidate: surveyed available site with frog presence/detection in target year
response_semantics_gate.negative_candidate: surveyed available site with documented non-detection/absence under the archived monitoring design
response_semantics_gate.unavailable_state: pond-year lacking habitat availability/water under the archived hydroperiod contract; not an ordinary binary negative
response_semantics_gate.forbidden_negative: missing/not-surveyed/unavailable pond-year must never be recoded as absence
response_semantics_gate.pass_requirement: schema/code/documentation must distinguish surveyed non-detection from missing/not-surveyed and habitat unavailability before response values are inspected
response_semantics_gate.stop_requirement: if only positive presence rows exist or survey effort/availability cannot be separated from absence, stop pre-response

allowed_at_gate0: Figshare version metadata, file names, sizes, checksums and download URLs
exact file bytes for checksum verification
bounded first physical record of text-like data files via eog.v2.validation.read_bounded_first_record_text
binary-file inventory without deserializing response objects
forbidden_at_gate0: using published aggregate results to tune EOG design

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen rule identities retained for compatibility, current-source propagation, sequential contraction and finite-universe falsification

structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.distance_basis: archive-provided site coordinates or explicit distance matrix only; no response-derived geometry
requirements: at least three distinct positive structural thresholds
structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.no_rescue: do not add kNN/arbitrary thresholds after a scale-diversity failure

external_comparator_class.primary: published-style spatial occupancy/metapopulation model using hydroperiod, patch isolation and landscape resistance/connectivity
external_comparator_class.flexible: predeclared flexible classifier using only the same response-free site/availability/geometry information
external_comparator_class.freeze_later: exact comparator features/hyperparameters and temporal holdout are frozen only after Gate 0 and structural gates pass, still before occupancy response rows

pass_if_all: Figshare v4 metadata and exact source bytes are reproducibly frozen
response-bearing files are separable from code/documentation/geometry
wetland node universe is habitat/survey-defined rather than future-response-defined
coordinates or explicit distances are response-free and deterministic
surveyed non-detection can be distinguished from missing/not-surveyed/unavailable
11-year monitoring structure is available for a prospective temporal holdout
conditional internal-source propagation remains scientifically defensible
stop_if_any: source bytes cannot be reproducibly frozen
surveyed absence cannot be separated from missing/not-surveyed/unavailable
process/source semantics are incompatible with an internal-source conditional forecast

post_gate0_sequence: freeze canonical wetland universe and full response-free geometry/availability inputs
run the same response-blind structural scale/adequacy Gate 1 used after Glanville
freeze published-style spatial occupancy comparator and flexible external comparator
freeze temporal calibration/heldout split from metadata only
only then open occupancy/detection response rows once
no_rescue_rule: If Gate 0 or structural adequacy fails, stop pre-response and move to another candidate rather than altering EOG worlds or endpoint definitions.
